drivingQuestion: Is the year of redemption counted from the owner's sale to the first buyer or from the first buyer's sale to the second?
outcomeNote: The baraita's derash settles the count from the first sale, as the mishna ruled.

segments.he: אֵין מוֹנִין לוֹ שָׁנָה אֶלָּא מִשָּׁעָה שֶׁמָּכַר כּוּ׳. תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: שָׁנָה — אֵינִי יוֹדֵעַ אִם שָׁנָה לָרִאשׁוֹן אִם שָׁנָה לַשֵּׁנִי, כְּשֶׁהוּא אוֹמֵר ״עַד מְלֹאת לוֹ שָׁנָה תְמִימָה״ — הֱוֵי שָׁנָה לָרִאשׁוֹן.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches that if the buyer sold the house to another, «one calculates» the «year only from the time that» the owner «sold» the house to the first buyer, as it is stated: “And if it is not redeemed until the passage of a full year for him” (Leviticus 25:30). «The Sages taught:» When the verse states «“year,” I do not know if» one counts the «year» from when the owner sold it «to the first» buyer, or «if» one counts the «year» from when the first buyer sold it «to» the «second. When» the verse «states: “Until the passage of a full year for him,” you must» say that it is «a year» from when the owner sold it «to the first» buyer.

moves.cueHe: אין מונין לו שנה אלא משעה שמכר כו׳
moves.summary: quotes the mishna's rule that the year runs from the original sale
moves.about: quotes the mishna's rule that the year is counted only from the original sale

moves.summary: brings the baraita that grounds that rule
moves.about: brings the baraita that derives the counting from the first sale

moves.cueHe: איני יודע אם שנה לראשון אם שנה לשני
moves.summary: the bare word שנה leaves it open which sale starts the count
moves.about: עד מלאת לו שנה תמימה settles that the year runs from the owner's sale to the first buyer

moves.cueHe: כשהוא אומר ״עד מלאת לו שנה תמימה״
moves.summary: the fuller phrase decides it: a year from the first sale
moves.about: the baraita supplies the scriptural ground for the mishna's rule that the year runs from the first sale
